title: 5-Min Avocado Silk Dark Chocolate Mousse
hookLine: Heart-healthy ripe avocados whip with dark cocoa & maple into velvety French-style mousse (zero avocado taste!).

items.name: Pure maple syrup + 1 tsp vanilla + espresso pinch

steps.title: Line Pan & Prep Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a loaf pan, baking dish, or serving glasses with parchment paper or chill them in the fridge for 5 minutes. Measure out {av_avo} and {av_coc} so your base whips up thick, creamy, and clump-free.

steps.title: Blend Avocados, Cocoa & Maple
steps.instructionTemplate: Blend {av_avo}, {av_coc}, and {av_map} with 3 tbsp almond milk until glossy, piped-mousse smooth. Chill 20 mins. Chill or freeze until completely firm and set, then portion into 4 servings and store leftovers in an airtight container.
steps.creatorSecret: A tiny pinch of espresso powder + sea salt makes it taste 100% like classic dark chocolate ganache.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {av_map} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Chill Until Firm, Slice & Store
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover and refrigerate 5-Min Avocado Silk Dark Chocolate Mousse until completely firm and sliceable. Portion into 4 servings, add any crisp toppings right before serving, and keep leftovers chilled in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero refined sugar and only 215 cal—tastes like total indulgence!
